style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Adopt MOE figurative sense: a matter has reached its final conclusion. Modern school science project judging AFTER all experiments completed. Three adult judges review entire evidence sequence shown as picture-only photos laid in chronological order: prototype, several tests, final stable bridge supporting weight. Lead judge places final gold rosette beside the completed model and closes thick evaluation folder; the others agree with nods. Child team stands nearby relieved, tools packed and test apparatus stopped, all evidence gathered, no ongoing trial. A small earlier inset shows judges waiting while work was incomplete, no prize yet, to emphasize final judgment only after full completion. No coffin, death or readable text. Hands correctly close folder and place rosette, weight supported on model, table stable, natural anatomy. Landscape 3:2 pencil watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no letters numbers brands logos watermarks.
adopted_sense: 比喻事情最後已有結論
alt: 所有橋梁測試結束後，評審看完整套過程照片，把獎章放在成品旁並合上評分夾；小景顯示未完成時仍暫不評定。
